scope: Repair and bounded learning validation, not a new full P1 or P2
shutdown: Previous shutdown controller cancelled for this new active task; no automatic shutdown during validation

optimizer.batch_population: all response steps including zero advantage; same denominator and optimizer schedule

stages: CPU regression and offline gate feasibility
same frozen base repeated generation with exact prompts/seeds and stored processed sampling logprobs
bounded positive/negative update direction on actual saved samples
step-zero tune evaluation on all 40 games x 2 fixed seeds
four rounds each of GRPO and GiGPO style on fixed first 16 train games x 4 reps, shared initial rollout
evaluate training-task learning and paired tune change; no enlargement if not demonstrated
success_interpretation: Engineering gates do not establish generalization. Report fixed-seed train success changes and game-cluster bootstrap CIs on tune. No declaration of algorithmic benefit without a positive paired lower 95% bound. A failed check is retained and stops downstream work. Repairs require a new version/output namespace, never relaxed gates or overwritten outputs.
